in_sanskrit.name: नरोत्तम
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who is beyond the limit of virtues
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has transcended all virtues and has reached the pinnacle of moral excellence.

in_tamil.name: நரோத்தம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has transcended all virtues and has reached the pinnacle of moral excellence in the realm of human beings.

in_telugu.name: నరోద్దమ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has transcended all virtues and has reached the pinnacle of moral excellence in the realm of human beings.

in_marathi.name: Narottam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the People
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narottam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Naro means ‘man’ or ‘people’. Tama means ‘delight’ or ‘joy’. Narottam is a name for a person who brings happiness and joy to the people.

in_bengali.name: Narottam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the People
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narottam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Naro means ‘man’ or ‘people’. Tama means ‘delight’ or ‘joy’. Narottam is a name for a person who brings happiness and joy to the people.
